coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the nine ground-truth variable entries as scoring units, one fully matches (1/9 = 11%): attack type includes token-level AutoDAN and prompt-level PAIR. Other entries have only partial conceptual overlap or incorrect operational definitions.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the fixed 100-token suffix and required condition-specific default/zero-shot templates. It replaces the specified defender models and alignment/safety-prompt configurations with one abstract model and different defenses. Attacker model/query tiers and prompt-level model/edit tiers are missing. HarmBench replaces MaliciousInstruct. Its custom ASR rubric and open-source judge do not match ASRPrefix and GPT-4-based ASRAgent. It also introduces unsupported memory and QFS variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the highest ASRs for strong attackers against weak defenders, the reductions under strong defenses, the effectiveness of stacked defenses, or the dataset- and attack-specific interaction patterns.
